description: This file defines a SwiftUI View called HomeToolbar, which functions as a toolbar component in an iOS application. It includes subviews for status, chat, talk, and settings actions, as well as handling appearance and interaction logic.

classes.name: HomeToolbar
classes.description: Main toolbar view providing status and action buttons for quick access to features.

classes.name: HomeToolbarStatusButton
classes.description: A subview representing the gateway connection status with pulsing animation for connecting state.

classes.name: HomeToolbarActionButton
classes.description: A reusable button for toolbar actions like chat, settings, with visual feedback.

methods.name: body
methods.description: Builds the view layout for the HomeToolbar and its subcomponents.

methods.name: updatePulse
methods.description: Controls the pulsing animation for the status indicator when connecting.
